clips.clip_summary: 越过女生右肩前景拍摄男生的中近景，夕阳逆光下男生眼眶泛红、隐忍含泪向女生低声质问并坦白自己的坚定选择。
clips.detailed_action_and_dialogue: Subtle handheld slow push-in toward <CHR_2>, keeping the softly out-of-focus shoulder silhouette steady on the right foreground edge. <CHR_2> stands facing three-quarter right with reddened, tear-glossy eyes and furrowed brows, his throat tightening as he holds back surging grief and grievance. Leaning forward slightly in earnest, trembling restraint, <CHR_2> speaks (0.3s-4.5s): <d>[Chinese] 有没有可能，我也遇上了更好的，可我还是选择了你。</d> His voice is low and quivering with suppressed emotion; after finishing the line, his lips press together slightly as his glistening eyes stay fixed intently to the right, waiting for her answer.
clips.keyframe_prompt: Photorealistic live-action film frame, 16:9 aspect ratio, over-the-shoulder medium close-up at eye level in [Scene]. On the extreme right foreground edge, a softly blurred out-of-focus silhouette of dark brown wavy hair and a cream-white chunky knit shoulder frames the shot. Left of center stands [CHR_2] facing three-quarter right, wearing a light sky-blue stand-collar long-sleeve shirt, natural skin texture, reddened eyes glistening with unshed tears, brows slightly drawn in restrained hurt and grievance, lips just about to part. Behind him, semi-open grey-white concrete colonnade pillars and distant green campus trees and walkway are bathed in low-angle warm golden sunset backlight and side-backlight contrasting against cool grey architectural shadows. Clean cinematic composition, natural depth of field, no subtitles, no text, no watermarks.
clips.soundscape: Quiet late-afternoon campus courtyard ambience, gentle evening breeze rustling distant tree leaves, faint soft fabric rustle, and a quiet shaky breath.

clips.clip_summary: 反打女生中近景，女生闻言瞬间动容落泪，随即抬手擦去泪水强压心痛，以冷酷决绝的平静语气彻底斩断男生的挽留。
clips.detailed_action_and_dialogue: Static camera with a subtle slow push-in on <CHR_1> facing three-quarter left against the glass doors. From 0.0s to 1.4s, <CHR_1>'s eyes glisten and a single tear slips down her cheek as her expression flickers with brief, piercing heartbreak; she swallows hard to force down her vulnerability, quickly raises her hand to briskly wipe the tear from her cheek with her fingertips, and lowers her hand as her gaze hardens into cold, defensive detachment. Maintaining an icy, composed expression, <CHR_1> speaks (1.5s-3.5s): <d>[Chinese] 可我，没让你选我。</d> From 3.5s to 4.0s, she keeps her lips firmly closed and holds an unwavering, resolute gaze to the left.
clips.keyframe_prompt: Photorealistic live-action film frame, 16:9 aspect ratio, medium close-up at eye level in [Scene]. Positioned slightly right of center, [CHR_1] stands facing three-quarter left, shoulder-length dark brown straight hair with subtle waves, clear light makeup and natural skin texture, wearing a cream-white chunky knit cardigan over a dark brown square-neck fitted tank top with a dark brown leather shoulder bag strap on her shoulder. Her eyes are moist and glistening with a tear poised at her lower lash line, showing a fleeting tremor of sorrow and emotional wavering. Behind her on the right are metal-framed transparent glass double doors of the teaching building in cool grey concrete shadow, while warm golden sunset side-backlight rims her hair and cheek with a strong warm-cool contrast. Clean cinematic composition, shallow depth of field, no subtitles, no text, no watermarks.
clips.soundscape: Soft outdoor campus evening ambience, subtle breeze, light fingertip brush against skin and knit sleeve rustle as she wipes her tear, followed by quiet tense stillness.

scene_summary: 傍晚大学教学楼门外廊柱过渡区，暖金落日逆光与冷灰建筑阴影交织。全段共9秒拆分为2个正反打子镜头：第一镜（5秒）越过女生虚化肩部前景聚焦男生中近景，男生眼眶泛红、隐忍微颤地质问并坦白自己遇见过更好的人仍选择了她；第二镜（4秒）切至女生干净中近景，捕捉她闻言瞬间动容落泪、随即抬手拭泪强压心痛，并以冷酷决绝的语气说出“可我，没让你选我。”彻底斩断挽留。
